briefing: Markets were essentially flat today (NASDAQ +0.2%, S&P 500 +0.0%), so there was no broad risk-on or risk-off signal. With cash above the $500 threshold and 3 open slots, we deployed into TSEM and XENE, the only two names showing full multi-signal confirmation (RSI, MACD, price vs SMA-20, and volume all aligned), and left existing positions untouched.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum confirmation means waiting for several technical signals to line up together — like RSI in a healthy bullish range, a MACD bullish crossover, price above its moving average, and a volume surge — before buying. A single bullish signal can be noise, but when they all agree, it's a stronger sign that real buying interest (not just a random blip) is behind the move.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能確認是指在買入前,等待多個技術指標同時發出一致的訊號——例如RSI處於健康的上升區間、MACD出現黃金交叉、股價高於其移動平均線,以及成交量放大。單一的利好訊號可能只是噪音,但當所有訊號同時出現時,就更有力地顯示背後是真實的買盤興趣,而不是偶然的波動。

market_education.summary_en: Today's session was quiet with NASDAQ roughly flat (+0.2%) and the S&P 500 unchanged, suggesting no major macro catalyst moved sentiment either way. Trading activity was concentrated in individual stock stories rather than a broad index-wide move. No specific news headlines were available in today's feed to attribute the muted action to a single cause.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市表現平靜,納指微升0.2%,標普500指數幾乎沒有變動,反映市場缺乏明顯的宏觀催化劑帶動方向。成交主要集中在個股故事,而非整體指數的大幅波動。今日資訊未提供具體新聞標題,故未能歸因於單一事件。
